newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil court again delays decision on cellphones.
newsitem.headline: Brazil court again delays decision on cellphones.

text.p: Brazil's Supreme Federal Tribunal delayed for 10 days a ruling on the legitimacy of the government's plan to offer private companies concessions to operate Band B cellular service, tribunal President Sepulveda Pertence said.
Pertence said he was "perplexed" as to the constitutionality of a provisional law put in place by the government to serve as a legal base for its tendering of cellular services.
